episodes.177124: Isolated thunderstorms moved across portions of northern Illinois during the late evening of February 14th and the early morning of February 15th producing isolated severe wind gusts. ||Strong winds occurred from the evening of February 14th into February 15th.  During the evening of February 14th, a 400 foot tall wind turbine three miles east of Paxton in Ford County began leaning over.  A few days later, the wind turbine fell to the ground.  During the morning of February 15th, a wind gust to 59 mph was measured at the Rockford Airport and also 5 miles east of Herbert in McHenry County.  In Lake County, a wind gust to 58 mph was measured near Deerfield and a tree was blown down on railroad tracks near Highland Park.
episodes.177125: High winds developed over southern Lake Michigan during the morning of February 15th.
episodes.177899: Northwest winds occurred at Stannard Rock during the afternoon of the 15th.
episodes.177971: A potent storm system moving across Arizona dragged a cold front from west to east across south-central AZ. Along and ahead of the cold front, a line of showers and thunderstorms affected most of south-central Arizona resulting in frequent lightning, pea-sized hail, moderate to locally heavy rainfall as well as strong wind gusts in excess of 40 mph.

events.narrative: A large dead tree fell through a brick wall in a apartment complex in the area of Rural and Baseline Roads in Tempe as line of strong showers and storms associated with a cold front moved through. Timing estimated from radar. No injuries were reported.
Wind gusts were estimated between 50 and 60 mph.
